entities.name: New Covenant
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Prophesied by Jeremiah (31:31-34): a covenant written on the heart rather than stone tablets, with full forgiveness of sins. Christians identify this with Jesus' sacrifice ("This cup is the new covenant in my blood" — Luke 22:20).
